zoneraids.camp.chat.1: Sit down, warm up. The Zone will wait.
zoneraids.camp.chat.2: Got any bread? No? Never mind, there's sausage.
zoneraids.camp.chat.3: Keep your detector on, there's a whirligig past the trees.
zoneraids.camp.chat.4: We're off at first light. Nobody stays in one place for long here.
zoneraids.camp.chat.5: Heard the military are combing the area again. Watch the roads.
zoneraids.camp.chat.6: Bandits robbed a rookie down the road yesterday. Don't walk alone.
zoneraids.camp.chat.7: Artifacts turn up after an emission. Just make sure you live to see it.
zoneraids.camp.chat.9: The trader at the big camp pays well for artifacts. Better than us, anyway.
zoneraids.camp.chat.10: Dogs were howling all night. Means something big is near.

zoneraids.round.deathmatch.rules: Everyone against everyone, no extracts. The zone shrinks to the centre and hurts outside. Last one standing wins.

zoneraids.round.documents.rules: One player carries secret documents and glows. Extract with them for +2 perk points. If the carrier dies, anyone can pick them up.

zoneraids.round.emission.outside: Outside the shelter! The emission kills.
zoneraids.round.emission.rules: An emission is coming. The safe zone shrinks to a shelter and hurts outside. No extracts: survive inside the zone until the round ends.

zoneraids.survival.welcome: Welcome to the Zone. Your starter kit is in the inventory; the PDA is on K: trader, perks, health.
zoneraids.terminal.hint: [%s] or [Esc] to close · mouse wheel turns map pages
zoneraids.terminal.survival.1: Survival mode: an open world with no raids and no wipes; whatever you find is yours to keep.
zoneraids.terminal.survival.2: Blind dogs, fleshes, bandits and soldiers roam nearby; more at night and in Zone biomes, where snorks and bloodsuckers also come out.
zoneraids.terminal.survival.3: Find anomalies and artifacts in the Zone biomes: Red Forest, psi, thermal and bio zones. An artifact works inside a container in its Curios slot.
zoneraids.terminal.survival.4: Sell artifacts and valuables on the Trader tab; it also has guns, armor, medicine and a pit bike.
zoneraids.terminal.survival.5: Perks: a point per 10 enemies, 3 per boss. The PDA picks up lair signals: bandit base, ruined farm, Laboratory X.
zoneraids.terminal.survival.6: Stalker camps have a trader and guards, and no roaming enemies near them. Military bases and ruined villages and bases hide stashes and enemies.
